def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divrows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    divcols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    from collections import Counter
    divider = grid[divrows[0]][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    rbounds = [-1] + divrows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + divcols + [w]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(a + 1, b) for c in range(x + 1, y)) > 1 else background
             for x, y in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:]) if y - x > 1]
            for a, b in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:]) if b - a > 1]
